title_zh: 本次英語閱讀作答摘要
intro_zh: 閱讀兩篇短文並完成十題客觀題，確認流程、計分與結果說明是否清楚。

allowed: 研究者本人檢查流程、計分與結果呈現
描述本次十題中實際觀察到的作答
prohibited: 題目或 learner profile 已具效度
一般認知能力、注意力、記憶力、英文程度或 CEFR
穩定的 learner type 或閱讀速度能力

passages.title: Auditing a Streetlight Prediction Program
passages.text: A city tested a program that predicted which streetlights would fail. During the first month, repair crews inspected only lamps the program flagged. The city then praised the program because most recorded failures came from those same lamps. An independent auditor warned that this was a circular evaluation: lamps the program ignored had rarely been checked, so they had little chance to appear in the failure records. For a new trial, crews examined a representative sample from busy roads, quiet neighborhoods, old districts, and newly built areas. They also compared each crew's handheld meter with a certified electrical meter used as the reference instrument. The prediction system and the audit team kept separate records, and some inspections were scheduled without using the program's recommendations. This made it possible to compare predictions with observations gathered independently of the program.

passages.title: Choosing a Route After a Storm
passages.text: Two volunteer teams planned a supply route to an island village after a storm. One team used a tourist atlas, while the other used a navigation chart. Although both maps showed the same coast, the island looked wider on one. The instructor noted that no flat sheet preserves every feature of the globe; each map's projection treated shapes and distances differently. Before leaving, the crews checked the compass bearing from the harbor to the village and wrote the reading beside both routes. They also examined the shaded relief behind the village. A path that seemed short crossed a steep ridge, while a longer coastal path remained nearly level. The teams chose the coastal route and recorded which map and compass setting they had used. That record would let the return crew follow the same plan instead of assuming that the map with the largest-looking island was the most accurate.

items.prompt: In the passage, what does circular most nearly mean?

options.text: using evidence influenced by the same procedure being evaluated
repeating the evaluation at regular time intervals
limiting the evaluation to electrical measurements only
sending the evaluation to every city department
I do not know

items.explanation_zh: 程式先決定哪些路燈會被檢查，檢查又產生後來用來證明程式的紀錄，因此證據受到被評估程序本身影響。

items.prompt: In the passage, what does representative most nearly mean?

options.text: covering important kinds of lamps across the whole city
speaking officially on behalf of the repair crews
showing one familiar example from a busy road
symbolizing the city's public image and values
I do not know

items.explanation_zh: 新樣本刻意納入不同道路、社區、新舊區域，目的是反映整個城市的重要差異，而非只取單一典型案例。

items.prompt: In the passage, what does reference most nearly mean?

options.text: serving as a trusted standard for checking another measurement
providing a written source for the audit report
offering a typical example of a streetlight
replacing a device when the original one failed
I do not know

items.explanation_zh: 經認證的電表用來核對其他手持電表，因此 reference 在此是可信的比較標準。

items.prompt: Which change made it possible for lamps the program had not flagged to be examined?

options.text: Some inspections were scheduled without following the program's recommendations.
A certified meter was used to check the crews' handheld meters.
The audit team copied the program's original failure records.
Only lamps on busy roads were added to the new trial.
I do not know

items.explanation_zh: 只有獨立於程式建議安排部分檢查，原本沒有被標記的路燈才有機會進入稽核。

items.prompt: In the passage, what does projection most nearly mean?

options.text: a mapmaking method for representing the globe on a flat surface
a forecast of future changes to the island's coastline
an image enlarged from a device onto a screen
a viewing position chosen by a person reading the map
I do not know

items.explanation_zh: 文中比較平面地圖對球面地球形狀與距離的不同處理，因此 projection 指球面到平面的製圖方式。

items.prompt: In the passage, what does bearing most nearly mean?

options.text: a compass direction from one location toward another
a person's posture or manner while standing
the distance measured between two mapped locations
the weight that a bridge or structure can support
I do not know

items.explanation_zh: 隊伍用羅盤取得港口朝向村落的讀數，所以 bearing 指相對於北方表示的行進方向，不是距離。

items.prompt: In the passage, what does relief most nearly mean?

options.text: differences in land height represented on a map
a reduction in worry after danger has passed
emergency supplies delivered after a disaster
dark shading added only to decorate a map
I do not know

items.explanation_zh: shaded relief 幫助隊伍看出山脊與平坦海岸的高低差，因此此處是地形高度的表示。

items.prompt: Why did the teams choose the longer coastal path?

options.text: It avoided the steep ridge even though it was longer.
It was the shortest line drawn on the tourist atlas.
It used a compass direction that required no recording.
It made the island's shape look more accurate.
I do not know

items.explanation_zh: 短路線會穿越陡峭山脊；海岸路線雖較長但接近平坦，所以被選中。

items.context: A tutoring app labeled some students at risk and automatically assigned them additional quizzes. Months later, the company said its labels were accurate because those students had completed more quizzes than others. An evaluator called the argument circular.
items.prompt: Why is the argument circular in this context?

options.text: The evidence used to validate the label was partly produced by the label.
The evaluation returned at fixed intervals throughout the school year.
The evaluator considered only the students' final quiz scores.
The company sent the same report to every student.
I do not know

items.explanation_zh: at-risk 標籤先造成額外測驗，之後又拿額外測驗數量證明標籤正確，驗證證據受到原標籤影響。

items.context: Climate researchers combined old maps of Arctic sea ice. Coastlines did not align near the edges, even after scanning errors were corrected. Before measuring change, they checked the projection recorded for each map. The disagreement could otherwise be mistaken for real environmental change.
items.prompt: What does projection mean in this context?

options.text: the spatial conversion chosen when the globe was drawn as a map
the expected location of sea ice in future years
the brightness setting used when the map was scanned
the assumptions assigned to the earlier mapmakers
I do not know

items.explanation_zh: 研究者要先確認各地圖如何把地球表面轉成平面，否則不同投影造成的邊緣差異可能被誤認為環境變化。
